sql:
SELECT s.School
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] > 0.1
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM satscores st
    WHERE st.cds = s.CDSCode
    AND st.NumGE1500 >= 1
);
